verdict.rationale:
Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to Mixpanel data, explicitly including a Create-Dashboard tool ('Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports') and natural-language querying of events, funnels, retention, etc., which together enable an agent to build a dashboard end-to-end via MCP. This is corroborated by both docs and a probe confirming the MCP endpoint exists.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that an agent actually completed a full dashboard build end-to-end via the API (not just MCP docs), and no explicit mention of dashboard-creation via the plain REST API path.
